name: HandoffFootnote - ServerRender
description: The same footnote on the server render, where the browser's own address is not knowable yet, so the MCP command falls back to `npm run mcp`. Its pair with Default is the point: the copyable block shrinks to a fraction of its width while the two grey paragraphs above it do not move, which is the arrangement where a small mono box is most at risk of reading as a stray fragment instead of the third thing in a group.
